main.description: Reports where the requesting user's space repos live and whether their PDS can host spaces now. The client routes space reads and writes by the mode, and starts a migration when the mode is polyfill and the PDS supports spaces.

mode.description: Where the user's repos live after this call.

pdsSupportsSpaces.description: Whether the user's PDS serves the space methods a migration needs, as of the last check.

migration.description: Progress of a running migration. Absent when none runs.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.
